text:
Raj: quick follow-up from last night's p95 latency spike — postmortem is up at https://confluence.redwood/INC-2026-314. Need owners for the remediation items (dashboard, runbook, tuning) and a proposal for SLO/SLA tweaks. @lena @alice who can take dashboards and throughput?
Lena: I can own the dashboard + alert tuning. will add region smoke-tests and a dashboard panel for prefix-caching metrics. ETA: EOW. :thumbsup:
Alice: I'll take throughput tuning and batching configs. plan is: run a 20% canary with the new batcher and measure tail latency. timeline ~2 weeks (includes perf tests).
Tom: I'll update the runbook (failover steps + kv cache clear flow) and add the postmortem checklist. will also run a quick kv-cache audit tomorrow.
Priya: SRE-bot shows error budget delta -6% this week. recommend pausing non-critical experiments until we reset. also we should discuss tightening p95 target for tier-1 services.
Raj: proposal sketch: current p95 target = 200ms -> tighten to 180ms for tier-1; keep p99 SLA as-is for now. also add a throughput guardrail: max queue depth 500 for frontend pool. quick YAML proposal below for the rolling change: 
```
service: text-generation
slos:
  - name: p95_latency
    target_ms: 180
    window: 7d
  - name: p99_latency
    target_ms: 600
    window: 7d
guards:
  - name: max_queue_depth
    threshold: 500
```
Lena: question — do we need a canary for the SLO change? I'd prefer a staggered rollout: start with non-production, then internal traffic, then prod tier-1.
Alice: agree on staggered rollout. will coordinate canary with infra windows.
Tom: runbook change done (draft). added steps and a playbook to rollback batching. link: https://confluence.redwood/runbooks/kv-audit (draft).
Priya: tagging ops for a quick dashboard smoke test after Lena's updates. also adding a metric to show error-budget burn by customer tier.
sre-bot: Incident logged: INC-2026-314. Error budget change: -6%. Assigned owners: lena(dashboard), alice(throughput), tom(runbook), raj(oversight). Next review: Mon 10:00 PT.
Raj: OK locking owners and timelines. I'll open a single tracking ticket and invite everyone to weekly check-ins (Mon 10am PT). If anyone needs help re-prioritizing experiments, ping me.
Lena: adding tasks to board now and will post PRs for dashboard changes.
Alice: starting perf run tomorrow, will post baseline numbers in the tracking ticket.
Tom: kv-audit scheduled for tomorrow 09:00 PT.
Priya: pausing non-critical experiments today. will post status in the ticket.
Raj: thanks all — keeping this thread for async updates. if anything blocks, escalate here or @oncall.
